limitations: No direct real-time Vercel or database logs are available unless provided or connected.
Minute-based 10-minute recurring schedules are not supported by the task scheduler; hourly audit cycle was enabled.
Actions that alter user data, API contracts, billing contracts, or production secrets require human approval.

findings: Latest deployment confirmation was blocked by platform build quota.
10-minute recurring audit cycle is unsupported; hourly audit was enabled.
Enterprise demo mode was available through query parameter without environment guard.
actions_taken: Added environment guard to the add-ons page demo mode.

findings: Add-ons page used a hardcoded empty active add-ons list, so purchased add-ons could not appear active.
actions_taken: Created server-side active add-on lookup with fallback.
Added migration for persisted organization add-ons.
Updated add-ons page to use persisted active add-ons outside demo mode.
next_cycle_focus: Connect payment webhooks to persisted organization add-ons.
Verify latest deploy after platform quota reset.

findings: Deployment configuration had multiple daily scheduled jobs, which can trigger plan quota failures on low-tier deployments.
Direct payment-webhook add-on sync patch was blocked by tool safety rules because it touches sensitive billing code.
actions_taken: Created a protected daily maintenance aggregator route that runs scheduled maintenance tasks sequentially.
Reduced deployment schedule configuration to one daily job pointing to the maintenance aggregator.
next_cycle_focus: Have Codex wire add-on sync into the existing billing webhook locally.
Run latest deployment build after quota reset.
Apply persisted organization add-ons migration in the database.

findings: The public health endpoint returned operational configuration names that were unnecessary for external monitors.
actions_taken: Hardened the public health endpoint to return only generic health status, environment, commit and non-sensitive checks.
Kept no-store and nosniff headers for monitoring responses.
next_cycle_focus: Verify latest build status after deployment quota reset.
Connect external uptime monitor to the public health endpoint.
Continue billing add-on webhook sync with Codex in local environment.

findings: Several recent production issues were caused by malformed internal links containing undefined path segments or legacy organization routes.
There was no dedicated QA script to catch these patterns before deployment.
actions_taken: Added a route link quality scanner that fails on hardcoded undefined route segments and warns on legacy organization route patterns.
Added npm script quality:routes for Codex and CI usage.
next_cycle_focus: Run npm run quality:routes locally or in CI and fix any warnings.
Promote route quality scan into security:ci after false positives are resolved.
Continue billing add-on webhook sync with Codex in local environment.

findings: The route quality scanner existed but was not part of the main security CI chain, so Codex/CI could miss broken internal links during hardening runs.
actions_taken: Promoted the route quality scanner into security:ci immediately after preflight, before deeper security checks, typecheck and tests.
next_cycle_focus: Run npm run security:ci locally or in CI to validate the new quality gate.
Fix any route scanner warnings surfaced by the stricter pipeline.
Continue billing add-on webhook sync with Codex in local environment.
